name: Conformance: Dispatch Cross-Worker Handoff (RFC 0022 §A)
description: RFC 0022 §A — sequential fan-out across two children using `perWorkerOutputMappings` + `perWorkerInputMappings`. Child-a writes `sharedVar` via outputMapping; child-b reads `inputs.input = parent's sharedVar` via inputMapping. Asserts that the dispatch node's same-run parent variable bag is the handoff channel between sequential children. See dispatch-cross-worker-handoff.test.ts.
